title.narrative: Strengthening job creation and creativity in the agro-industrial sector in Lebanon

description.narrative: Through this expansion phase of the CELEP Project, UNIDO will continue supporting the agro-industrial sector by providing technical assistance and inputs for improving selected agro-processing facilities especially M<(>&<)>SMEs, in addition to the provision of market-oriented professional skills trainings to women and youth. The project takes into consideration the effects of the ever protracting issue of the refugee crisis that has weighed heavily on the Lebanese society and its economy, and aims at alleviating the effects of the crisis through the improvement of employment opportunities for vulnerable communities.
